title: Technical Program
description:
Job Summary Role Summary: We are seeking an experienced and highly organized SAP Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of SAP implementation, upgrade, rollout, and support projects. The ideal candidate will combine strong SAP program/project management expertise with hands-on proficiency in JIRA, including Agile project tracking, sprint planning, backlog management, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. Lead tactical activities and support overall strategic program objectives. Manage Epics, Sub-Epics, and Features for the Product Group in JIRA. Continuously assess issues, risks, opportunities, and dependencies and support their resolution. Track scope changes and manage change-control processes to prevent scope creep. Support the resolution of PDO and foundational dependencies with Product Managers. Remove blockers and impediments by ensuring issues are escalated to the appropriate governance forums. Facilitate lessons-learned sessions and support transition to steady-state operations. Lead end-to-end SAP project management for implementations, upgrades, roll-outs, and support enhancements. Manage SAP S/4HANA migrations, module deployments such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, HCM, and integration initiatives. Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, resource allocations, budgets, and risk registers. Own and administer JIRA boards, including creation and management of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Subtasks. Manage project backlogs and configure JIRA workflows, dashboards, custom fields, and reporting to meet SAP project requirements. Manage project governance activities, including status reporting, steering committee updates, RAID logs, and change-management processes. Drive continuous improvement of project-management practices, JIRA usage standards, and reporting templates across the SAP team. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience managing SAP projects involving implementation, upgrades, or support. Demonstrated expert-level, hands-on experience using JIRA on a daily basis. Strong expertise in JIRA board configuration, workflow automation, JQL queries, dashboard creation, and Confluence integration. Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall/Hybrid project delivery methodologies. Excellent stakeholder-management, communication, and presentation skills. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager, BIM CoPilot 
 Location: Chennai Type: Full time Reports to: Managing Director About the role Joseph Engineering Services (JES) is a BIM delivery company with over 260 BIM professionals. We are building CoPilot, an AI-assisted product for Revit modelling and coordination, used by our own teams first. We are hiring a Product Manager to own CoPilot delivery end to end: the roadmap, the release plan, and the day-to-day execution of a small, fast-moving development team. This is a hands-on role. You will be the single owner of what gets built, in what order, and when it ships. 
 What you will do Own the product roadmap and break it into clearly scoped milestones and releases. Define the scope of each release and write acceptance criteria that developers can build to and QA can test against. Manage the development team's execution day to day: make sure every developer is working on the right item, unblock them, and keep the backlog clean and prioritized. Run release management: decide what ships together, coordinate QA, sign off releases, and write release notes. Coordinate user acceptance testing with our BIM modelers and coordinators, and feed their findings back into the roadmap. Make sure the test data and models needed for each release are ready before development starts. Track and report delivery metrics: throughput, cycle time, blockers, and progress against milestones. Bring decisions to leadership with the context, the options and a recommendation. 
 What you will not do Write code. Developers own technical design and implementation. Line-manage the developers. You direct the work; their reporting line stays as is. Run sprints or ceremonies for their own sake. We work from a prioritized queue, not a sprint calendar. 
 What we are looking for Required 4+ years in product management or technical delivery management for software products, with releases shipped to real users. Strong at writing clear, testable requirements and acceptance criteria. Working knowledge of BIM and Revit: families, levels, clashes, coordination workflows. AEC industry experience, or product experience serving it. Comfortable running a backlog and a release calendar as the single source of truth, and keeping it honest. Direct communicator. Able to say no to a developer and to leadership, with the reason. Based in Chennai or Dubai, or willing to relocate. 
 Preferred Experience delivering with AI-assisted or agent-based development workflows. Prior background as a BIM coordinator, modeler or MEP engineer. Experience with QA and UAT coordination in a small team.
